quote: "Take the whole camp. The children will remember the archery; you'll remember watching them." — J. W.
answer: Three Generations at Pioneer is an 8-day family itinerary from James Wild & Co.: four nights at Londolozi Pioneer Camp, taken whole as a private homestead for up to twelve (six adults and six children, children six and over), with a private Land Rover and the Cubs Den children's programme, then three nights in Cape Town. You go by road from Johannesburg to Londolozi and by air to Cape Town.

days.title: Johannesburg to the homestead
days.line: By road to Londolozi · time on request
days.body: By road from Johannesburg (OR Tambo): the N12 and N4 east to Nelspruit, the R40 through White River to Hazyview, then the R536 towards Paul Kruger Gate. About 37 km along it, a gravel road turns off to the Sabi Sand's Shaws Gate, where the reserve charges an entry fee per person and per vehicle. From the gate it is about 17 km to camp, following Londolozi's signs.
days.stay: Londolozi Pioneer Camp, the whole camp

days.title: The Cubs Den
days.body: Londolozi's Cubs Den children's programme for the young ones: tracking, tree climbing and archery [the order of the days to confirm with the lodge]. The grown-ups take the private Land Rover out.
days.stay: Londolozi Pioneer Camp, the whole camp

days.title: Fishing, baking and pizza
days.body: More of the Cubs Den: fishing, baking and pizza making, with Pioneer Camp's interactive kitchen for the family's own table [order to confirm with the lodge].
days.stay: Londolozi Pioneer Camp, the whole camp

days.title: S'mores and stars
days.line: The last night on the Sand River
days.body: Londolozi sits on the Sand River in the western Sabi Sand, unfenced to Kruger National Park. A last day on the private Land Rover, the lap pool in the afternoon, and the Cubs Den's s'mores and stargazing after dark.
days.stay: Londolozi Pioneer Camp, the whole camp

days.title: Londolozi to Cape Town
days.body: Londolozi has its own airstrip, used by charter flights. You fly to Cape Town [charter for the party to confirm]; Ellerman House is about 26 km, around 30 minutes, from the airport, with complimentary airport transfers.
days.stay: Ellerman House [Cape Town stay to confirm with James for a party of twelve]

days.body: The house's indigenous gardens and its South African art collection, or Cape Town with the concierge's help.

founder.title: He went to Londolozi with his daughter
founder.p1: James stayed at Londolozi in 2018 with his daughter and toured every room. In May 2026 he stayed at Ellerman House.
founder.p2: This is the route for the family that wants to be together: the whole of Pioneer Camp, a Land Rover of your own, the Cubs Den for the children, and three nights in Cape Town to finish.

faqs: How many people can stay at Pioneer Camp?
Taken whole as a private homestead, Pioneer Camp holds up to 12: six adults and six children, with children aged six and over.
Londolozi's children's programme: tracking, tree climbing, archery, fishing, baking, pizza making, s'mores and stargazing.
Do we have our own vehicle?
Yes. The family has a private Land Rover for the stay.
Three suites of 138 m², an interactive kitchen and a lap pool, at Londolozi in the western Sabi Sand.
How do we get from Londolozi to Cape Town?
By air. Londolozi has its own airstrip for charter flights; we arrange the flight for your party.
It is a low-risk malaria area. Precautions are still advised; ask your doctor before you travel, including for the children.
How much does Three Generations at Pioneer cost?
It is quoted against your dates and party, with any current offer applied. James Wild & Co does not publish a fixed price for this route.
